search_procedure: Run the fixed initial query for every new slot and retain all results. Within returned official results, take up to two candidate releases that explicitly concern the target national cumulative period, ordered by apparent carrier date then URL; dates outside the cutoff do not qualify. A fixed fallback query is allowed only when no eligible original has been established, and consumes the same two-original cap. Do not query reported numbers, ETF returns or alternative periods. Each network claim precedes its request. No redirects or same-URL retries; preserve failures.
transport: Temporary requests.Session trust_env=False, TLS certificate verification enabled, based on retained successful pilot transport; no machine-wide proxy or security changes.
selection: Use the earliest qualifying carrier in this bounded retained manifest, not a claim of globally earliest publication. If same-date earliest qualified originals disagree, the slot is unknown. Later versions remain retained and cannot replace the earliest value. Search snippets alone never supply a value. A retained full web rendering may be used only if clearly labelled as not original bytes; raw originals are preferred.
exact_conflict_rule: Parse the printed percentage as Decimal, treating trailing zeros, leading plus, ordinary/fullwidth percent punctuation and explicit increase/decrease sign words as formatting only. Any unequal normalized Decimal values among the earliest same-date qualified sources, or an internal conflict in a carrier, make the slot unknown. No numerical tolerance or rounding-based reconciliation.
late_episode_rule: Report all later-slice overlapping selected episodes, carried-in episodes and new starts separately. An episode already selected before2020Q1is carried-in and does not count toward the predeclared minimum3later episodes; at least3new starts within the later slice are required. This conservative clarification is fixed before signal construction.
missing_policy: Retain all46reference slots, including the two frozen pilot unknowns and any collection failures. No interpolation, CNY/month-only substitution, amount-derived growth, period replacement or cutoff extension.
historical_vintage: Current historical carrier labels remain conditional reconstructed evidence; neither source hashes nor retrieval success certify immutable first publication.
